items.title: Your language, a real community, and help when you need it
items.summary: Lantern Keeper now speaks eight languages, the community has live chat and channels, and help is one tap away: a help assistant, private support tickets and clearer Supporter Club details. Plus this weekend's Lanterns Rekindled event and local peso prices.

items: The game and the website in English, Filipino, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Indonesian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese (Simplified).
The game follows your device's language; change it any time in Settings > Display > Language.
Chat, names and posts always stay as people wrote them.
Channels for news, devlogs by version, events, giveaways, ideas, feedback and bug reports, and live chat in General and Game discussion.
Mentions, a notification bell, who is online now, search, reactions and polls, on a phone too.
Private support tickets for your account, a payment or the Club, with a screenshot if you need one.
A help assistant on every page answers common questions and passes you to a person when it can't.
Lanterns Rekindled, Saturday and Sunday: +50% embers from every night, and play 3 nights to keep the Rekindled lantern.
Show Us Your Lighthouse, until 17 October: post a screenshot in the community for the Community Founder badge. Three winners get the Spotlight lantern, the Featured Keeper title and 250 Lumens.
Lower prices in pesos, and the Supporter Club at $2.99 / ₱149 a month.
Your Club plan, price, next payment date and status, and a clear way to cancel: you keep the benefits until the end of the month you paid for.
PayPal or card, GCash and bank transfer as separate choices; every order shows its method, amount, status and reference.
Show or hide your password when you type it.
New-look emails, sent only for what you chose.

items.title: A home for keepers: notifications, a store, the Supporter Club and the community
items.summary: The website becomes the home of Lantern Keeper: a store, your account and a community with news and devlogs from the team. Plus the Supporter Club, supporter packs, a Notification Center, emails you choose, Bazaar gates that open one at a time, a faster start and stronger fair play.

items: Sign in on the website with your game account: your profile, supporter status, purchases and email choices.

The community: news, development updates, the roadmap and devlogs from the team; feedback, bug reports, feature requests, artwork and screenshots from keepers, with pictures, polls, reactions and follows.
The store on the website: everything the game sells, with PayPal, cards, GCash or bank transfer.
Starter, Dedicated and Founder supporter packs with Lumens, looks, frames, badges and titles.
The Supporter Club, monthly: a new lantern each month to keep, the Club frame, badge and title, and the Supporter Lounge.
Everything sold is looks and recognition only: it never makes anyone stronger.
The bell on the home screen: announcements, friend requests, invitations, challenges, achievements and festivals in one list, each shown once.
Choose which kinds appear and pop up in Settings > Notifications. Important notices always show.
Notifications while the game is in the background on computers and in browsers, and push notifications on Android, if you turn them on.
Patch notes and updates, events, a daily "From friends" round-up of what you missed, and promotions for players 18 and over: each one off unless you turn it on in Settings > Account > Emails.
Every email has a one-click link that stops just that kind.
Lumen packs and the Supporter Pack on Windows, Mac, Linux, the web version and the Android app from this website.
Pay with PayPal or a card, or with GCash (scan the QR code) or a bank transfer. Prices in pesos in the Philippines and US dollars everywhere else.
Everything sold is cosmetic: it never makes you stronger.
The district gates now open one at a time, each with its own task, so every keeper earns them the same way.
The townsfolk, the trees and the street lamps are finally out in the street.

notes.h: Fair play and a faster start
items: The server checks more of every save: nights, bosses, creatures, regions and achievements can only grow as fast as real play allows.
A save changed outside the game is never sent to your account.
The game starts faster in the web version and the desktop app, about half the time from the third launch.
A 32-bit Windows installer, Linux on ARM64 (Raspberry Pi 4 and 5), and older browsers such as Firefox ESR 115.
Anonymous gameplay statistics, only if you agree, help us find what to improve. Never your name, email or account.
Privacy Policy 3.0 and Terms 1.6 explain all of the above.

items.title: Every screen, every device, together
items.summary: The game's own dropdowns and a bottom bar that fits Android's navigation, a real co-op lobby with Ready and connection quality, friendly duels with friends, a daily public chat, a Lantern Bazaar you can browse and try looks on, and a bigger website with honest compatibility labels.

items: Android's navigation bar no longer leaves an empty band under the bottom menu.
Dropdowns are the game's own on every device: a panel on a computer, a sheet on a phone; keyboard, controller and touch all work.
Settings has a proper cog icon, and the Lantern Bazaar is in the main menu.
One game icon everywhere: the Android and iPhone apps now show the lighthouse too.
Scrollbars in the game's colours, and achievement notices that never cover the bottom menu.
Phones turned sideways: every button fits, nothing hides under your name, and notices stay clear of the side menu.
The game fills the whole screen on wide monitors and tablets, without dark bands at the sides.
See every keeper's look, keeper, weapon, how they play and their connection.
Partners press Ready; Start asks first if someone isn't ready. Invite shares the room code or invites a friend.
New pings: Wait, Ready?, Focus here, Defend, Good job.
Challenge a friend to a friendly duel: no rating change, and you choose who may challenge you.
Friends see what you are doing while you are online.
Community and region chat is a daily conversation, fresh at midnight UTC.
Fixed: an emote could be sent twice.
A panel to browse looks, weapons, charms, materials and collections, preview them on your keeper and wear them.
More detail in the street on higher graphics settings, and the collection of the day at the entrance.
The street fills the whole window, the panel fits what it shows and can be hidden, and the street no longer comes back dark after the window is resized.

District keys: every gate is locked until you earn its key with a task (play nights, defeat bosses, earn achievements, clear a region), then walk up and it opens for good. Some open for a day or an event: Sunday music night, festivals, the weekend market.
Townsfolk walk the street, lanterns float over the harbour and fireflies drift by the trees.
The account switches (cloud save, profile, news emails) showed Off and could not be turned on.
A match that ended could interfere with a quick rematch.
Two devices open at once no longer keep asking which save to keep: idle embers from either device are added together, and you are asked only when both devices made real progress.
Sign out now signs out only the device you are holding.
Start over: a fresh start for your account, from Account, after you type START OVER.
Every download with its details and an honest status label, a compatibility table, earlier versions.
Community and Press kit pages, a live service status, RSS and Atom feeds.
Privacy Policy 2.9 covers the daily chat, duel requests, friends' activity and the co-op lobby.

items.title: Play anywhere, together
items.summary: Online co-op is ready to be run by the game's own server: the fairest kind of co-op, where no player's device decides for the others. The game has a Downloads page for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android, an app file for iPhone and iPad, and is tested on Safari so iPhone players meet everyone else on equal terms.

items.title: Collections, the Market and the Workbench
items.summary: Four themed collections of looks, a Market to swap items with any keeper, materials found on the coast and crafted into boosts at the Workbench, festival tokens to trade for looks you missed, and music you unlock by playing.

items.title: The Lantern Bazaar
items.summary: A walkable 3D harbour where keepers meet between the nights, the Collection of everything you have found, a Satchel with search and filters, a controller map, and a web version you can install and play offline.

items.title: Every screen
items.summary: Graphics presets from Low to Ultra, a frame-rate limit, text size, high contrast, colour-vision palettes, captions for sounds, left-handed and resizable touch buttons, and a margin for TVs. Tested on eleven screen sizes, from a small phone to 4K.

items.title: Every controller
items.summary: Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo-style and Steam Deck controllers, with buttons named for yours, remapping, an on-screen keyboard, and menus that work without a mouse.

items.title: Trading
items.summary: Trade boosts and keepsakes with your friends: put items in your Trade chest, make an offer, and both keepers confirm before anything moves.

items.title: The Satchel
items.summary: Boosts for a single PvE night and keepsakes found along the coast. Boosts never work in PvP.

items.title: Everything has a face
items.summary: Every weapon, keeper and charm drawn as itself, with lore for all of them, and a preview that compares an item with what you have.

items.title: The wardrobe
items.summary: Six skin tones and new hats, scarves and coats, with a Keeper screen to try them on before you save.

items.title: PvP Battle
items.summary: Ranked 1v1: build your lantern over three waves, then duel another keeper live. Ratings, tiers, a leaderboard, and practice against an AI keeper.

items.title: Together, and the Living World
items.summary: Online co-op for up to four keepers, friends, parties and chat, community goals, regions VIII to XXV with five acts and an ending, festivals, and over a thousand achievements and challenges.

items.title: Accounts and cloud saves
items.summary: A free account keeps your progress in the cloud and on every device. New route stops, events, hazards, guardians with phases, and the Ashen Shoals and Whispering Marsh.

items.title: Deeper waters
items.summary: Two new regions with longer routes, new creatures and guardians, and Ascension levels 1 to 10.

items.title: Four keepers and music
items.summary: Co-op for up to four keepers, co-op expeditions, reconnecting after a dropped connection, music, and the Android app.

items.title: The Keeper update
items.summary: Your profile with titles and records, five lighthouses, new weapons and keepers, weekly goals, the Boss Rush, and co-op over Wi-Fi or phone to phone.

items.title: The first co-op
items.summary: Two keepers on one lighthouse, relighting the lighthouse, relics and the daily challenge.

items.title: The world and the arsenal
items.summary: The world map with its first regions, weapons and keepers to choose, the Loadout, charms and the Codex.
